main_body: Two stacked wooden crates; the large left crate has a plank-striped lid and a dark front face with a diagonal brace, and a smaller crate sits at the right.
top_band: Light tan planks, rows 1-8 (L 146/113 alternating), starting under a 1-row outline at row 0. A dark edge at row 9 (L=44) separates them from the front face.
evidence: Column x=15 reads: a light lid of 8 rows (tan with striping), then a 1-row dark shadow at row 9 (L=44), then an 8-row mid-dark front face (rows 10-17, L=65), then a dark base. The step from L~146 to L~44-65 is far above 25. The lid is a large horizontal surface, comparable in height to the front face, so this is not a rim or a front elevation with a hat. The diagonal brace is painted flat on the front rather than inset. There is no distinct lighter front-edge line, but the dark row under the lid acts as an eave shadow. The smaller crate at the right follows the same top-plus-front structure. Passes as a 3/4 box.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours and a median of 6 per tile, against 38-40 colours and 17-20 per tile in the references. The wood ramp is only about 4 steps: two alternating tan stripes, a dark brown face and a near-black base. The front face is a large flat brown field with one diagonal line and no grain, knots, nail dots or per-plank highlights. The lid is plain alternating stripes with no wood texture. The outline is a tinted dark brown (only 12% neutral edge pixels), which is fine. Overall it is clearly thinner and flatter than the Beodeul references.
